title: One request per tick
hints: A ticker is a natural rate limiter: receive from ticker.C before handling each request, and the requests can't go faster than the ticks.
Create the ticker before the loop and defer ticker.Stop(). Inside the loop: <-ticker.C, then handle(r).
ticker := time.NewTicker(every); defer ticker.Stop(); for _, r := range reqs { <-ticker.C; handle(r) }
